AmpliHero.headline: Let's amplify common sense
AmpliHero.subhead: An army of humans working for the common good. A peer-to-peer trust network that amplifies your ideas to the whole world.

AmpliIntro.headline: How does it work?
AmpliIntro.subhead: A collaborative platform that transforms good ideas into concrete actions through the power of the collective.
AmpliIntro.trustedNetworkText: A peer-to-peer ecosystem where each member is validated by the community
AmpliIntro.collectiveValidationText: Your ideas are evaluated by peers who share your values
AmpliIntro.globalAmplificationText: The best proposals are widely disseminated outside the network
AmpliIntro.mediaPulseText: Creation of a regular rhythm to maintain public attention
AmpliIntro.networkEffectText: The more we are, the greater our impact grows exponentially
AmpliIntro.commonGoodText: Every action aims to improve society as a whole
